title: 第9章 快到为师的碗里来
slug: 史上第一祖师爷全本免费-史上第一祖师爷最新章节列表
content_zh:
“小不点啊小不点，快到为师的碗里来。”林锋心中大声呐喊，但表面上仍一脸淡然的看着小不点，静静问道：“为师留给你的护符，用掉了？”
小不点不好意思的挠挠头，小脸微红：“咿呀，用掉了呢，我之后也去找过，但找不到了。”
林锋淡然一笑：“无妨，本就是留给你护身用的，为师也是感应到护符有变，所以才又返回来。”
小不点笑道：“谢谢道长除掉老树妖，救了大家。”
林锋微笑，又取出一枚护符递给小不点：“收好了，以后自己多小心，为师还有事，咱们就此别过，有缘再见吧。”
兑换的雷系晶石已经消耗殆尽，仅凭这枚护符是发动不了九天动雷引的，但这不妨碍林锋装装样子。
说罢林锋长身而起，收了北极天磁剑，就往门外走。
小不点懵懂的点头，老村长却楞在当场，他还以为林锋会旧事重提，收小不点为弟子。
老人家希望林锋收小不点为徒，可又担心小不点的身世会泄露，正纠结呢，谁知林锋竟然直接就要走了。
林锋脸色平淡，向院子外面走去，周围的石村村民都一脸敬畏感激的给他让开道路。
“一，二，三……”林锋边走边在心中默数，他当然不可能就这么一走了之，否则他忙活半天是干什么呢？
只不过做戏做全套，既然是扮演世外高人，那就必须要有世外高人的架子。
太轻易得到的东西，人往往不会珍惜，师徒之间也是如此，自己太主动了，老村长和小不点反而会有疑虑，自己不那么热衷，他们才会积极的贴上来。
果然，当林锋心中数到“十”的时候，身后传来老村长的声音：“仙长还请留步！”
“稳妥的很。”林锋心中暗笑，脸上神情不变，转过身也不说话，就这么平静的看着老村长。
老人家明显是下定了决心，牵着小不点的手走过来，谦卑但郑重的说道：“这孩子自幼多灾多难，能得仙长青睐是他的造化，还请仙长垂怜，收下这孩子。”
林锋知道这时候要展现自己的大气，于是也不拿捏，只是平静的说道：“谈不上青睐垂怜，能续前世师徒缘分，本座也很高兴，但是否愿意重归本座门下，还要这孩子自己拿定主意。”
老村长沉吟了一下后，对着周围众人说道：“大家都散了吧，这几天连出大事，家里面都乱，都先回去吧。”
村民们虽然奇怪，但村长发话了，于是也就一一散去，临走前又是对着林锋千恩万谢。
片刻后，院子里只剩下林锋、老村长和小不点三个人，老村长躬身说道：“小老儿有些隐情，仙长容禀，还请入内说话。”

林锋不在意的一点头，三人一起进了石屋坐下，老村长怜爱的看着小不点：“小不点，你愿意拜这位仙长为师吗？”
小不点乌溜溜的大眼睛亮得发光，看着林锋：“能学跟仙长一样的大本事吗？”
林锋微微一笑：“更大的都有。”
小不点顿时连连点头，一脸期盼：“呀，我愿意，我愿意。”
林锋笑容收起，徐徐说道：“不过，你若是拜我为师，就要跟为师离开村子了，为师不会在这里久留。”
小不点一听，顿时犹豫起来，眼巴巴的望着林锋，又看向老村长。
老村长干咳一声，肃容道：“小不点，你不是总问我，爸爸妈妈去哪了吗？”
小不点眨了眨眼睛，说道：“我脑子里有些印象，可是总也想不起来，爷爷你终于肯讲给我听啦？”
老村长点点头，又望向林锋：“仙长容禀，这孩子……他的身世很不一般，日后或许会给您带来麻烦，他……他出身大秦皇朝皇室，更与大秦朝于氏家族有关。”
林锋心里微微一跳，这个天元大世界的皇朝跟地球历史上的皇朝可不一样，能登基为皇统治一国的，都是强大的修真者。
所谓皇朝皇室，倒不如说强大之极的修真者家族，足以和大宗门相抗衡。
林锋知道老人家这是在做最后的试探，不过他绝不会放弃小不点这个徒弟。
开玩笑，在小不点这种真命天子级别的人物面前，管你是万年宗门还是千年皇朝，都只有当背景板、垫脚石的份儿，道路或许曲折，前途注定光明。
更何况，退一步来说，林锋这个超级祖师系统的终极任务是要建立史上第一宗门，要完成这个任务，自然会与世界上现有大势力发生碰撞。

content_en:
"Little one, little one, come quickly to my master's bowl." Lin Feng shouted loudly in his heart, but on the surface he still looked at the little one with an indifferent expression, and asked quietly: "Have you used the amulet that my master left for you?"
The little one scratched his head in embarrassment, his face slightly red: "Hey, it was used. I looked for it later, but couldn't find it."
Lin Feng smiled calmly: "It doesn't matter, it was originally left for you to protect yourself. I also sensed that the amulet had changed, so I returned it."
The little one smiled and said, "Thank you, Taoist Priest, for getting rid of the old tree demon and saving everyone."
Lin Feng smiled and took out another amulet and handed it to the little one: "Put it away and be more careful in the future. I still have things to do as a teacher, so let's say goodbye and see you again when we have the chance."
The exchanged thunder crystals have been exhausted. This talisman alone cannot activate the Nine Heavens Thunder, but this does not prevent Lin Feng from pretending.
After saying that, Lin Feng stood up, put away the Arctic Sky Magnetic Sword, and walked out the door.
The little boy nodded ignorantly, but the old village chief was stunned on the spot. He thought that Lin Feng would bring up the old matter again and accept the little boy as his disciple.
The old man hoped that Lin Feng would accept the little boy as his disciple, but he was worried that the little boy's life experience would be revealed. Just as he was struggling, who knew that Lin Feng was about to leave immediately.
Lin Feng's face was calm and he walked out of the yard. The surrounding Shicun villagers all gave way to him with expressions of awe and gratitude.
"One, two, three..." Lin Feng counted silently in his mind as he walked. Of course he couldn't just leave like that, otherwise what would he be doing for so long?
It's just a full show. Since you are playing the role of an outsider, you must have the airs of an outsider.
People often don't cherish things that are obtained too easily, and the same is true between masters and disciples. If you are too proactive, the old village chief and the little boy will have doubts. If you are not so enthusiastic, they will actively stick to it.
Sure enough, when Lin Feng counted to "ten" in his heart, the old village chief's voice came from behind him: "Please stay, Immortal Chief!"
"It's very safe." Lin Feng secretly smiled in his heart, the expression on his face remained unchanged, he turned around without saying a word, and just looked at the old village chief calmly.
The old man had obviously made up his mind. He held the little one's hand and walked over. He said humbly but solemnly: "This child has been in many troubles since he was a child. It is his good fortune to be favored by the immortal. Please have mercy on the immortal and accept this child."
Lin Feng knew that he had to show his magnanimity at this time, so he didn't hesitate and just said calmly: "I can't say favor and pity. I am also very happy to be able to renew the fate of master and disciple in my previous life, but whether I am willing to return to my sect or not, I have to make up my mind for this child."
After the old village chief pondered for a while, he said to the people around him: "Everyone, please disperse. There have been major incidents in the past few days and the house has been in chaos. Everyone should go back first."
Although the villagers were surprised, the village chief had spoken, so they dispersed one by one, thanking Lin Feng profusely before leaving.
After a while, there were only three people left in the yard: Lin Feng, the old village chief, and the little one. The old village chief bowed and said, "The old man has something to hide. I'm kind enough to please come in and talk."
Lin Feng nodded nonchalantly, and the three of them entered the stone house and sat down together. The old village chief looked at the little one lovingly: "Little one, are you willing to accept this immortal as your teacher?"
The little boy's big black eyes were so bright that he looked at Lin Feng: "Can you learn the same great skills as the immortal?"
Lin Feng smiled slightly: "There are bigger ones."
The little boy immediately nodded his head, looking forward to it: "Yeah, I do, I do."
Lin Feng's smile disappeared and he said slowly: "However, if you want to become my master, you will have to leave the village with me. I will not stay here for long."
When the little boy heard this, he immediately hesitated and looked at Lin Feng eagerly, then at the old village chief.
The old village chief coughed dryly and said solemnly: "Little one, don't you always ask me where my parents are?"
The little one blinked and said:"I have some impressions in my mind, but I can't remember them. Grandpa, are you finally willing to tell me?"
The old village chief nodded and looked at Lin Feng: "Immortal Chang Rongzhen, this child... his life experience is very unusual. He may bring you trouble in the future. He... he is from the royal family of the Great Qin Dynasty, and is related to the Yu family of the Great Qin Dynasty."
Lin Feng's heart skipped a beat. The dynasty in this Tianyuan world was different from the dynasties in Earth's history. Those who could ascend the throne and rule a country as emperor were all powerful cultivators.
The so-called dynasty royal family is better to say that the cultivator family is extremely powerful, enough to compete with the large sects.
Lin Feng knew that the old man was doing his final test, but he would never give up on the little boy as his apprentice.
Just kidding, in front of a person like Xiao Bu Dian, who is the right person, no matter whether you are a ten thousand year sect or a thousand year dynasty, you can only serve as a backdrop and a stepping stone. The road may be twists and turns, but the future is destined to be bright.
What's more, to take a step back, the ultimate mission of Lin Feng's super ancestor system is to establish the first sect in history. To complete this mission, it will naturally collide with the existing major forces in the world.
